name: Demo advisory feed (OSV format)
note: Four public CVEs (version ranges and CVSS vectors transcribed from public advisories for demonstration) and three SYNTHETIC advisories (DEMO-*) for fictional automotive components. For real monitoring, load a current OSV export instead.

vulnerabilities.summary: zlib inflate heap buffer over-read/overflow via a large gzip header extra field (inflateGetHeader)
vulnerabilities.details: zlib through 1.2.12 has a heap-based buffer over-read or buffer overflow in inflate in inflate.c via a large gzip header extra field. Only applications that call inflateGetHeader are affected.

vulnerabilities.summary: OpenSSL 3.0 X.509 email address 4-byte buffer overflow during certificate verification
vulnerabilities.details: A buffer overrun can be triggered in X.509 certificate verification, specifically in name constraint checking. Fixed in OpenSSL 3.0.7.

vulnerabilities.summary: OpenSSL TLS heartbeat extension out-of-bounds read discloses process memory (Heartbleed)
vulnerabilities.details: The TLS and DTLS implementations in OpenSSL 1.0.1 before 1.0.1g do not properly handle Heartbeat Extension packets, which allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information from process memory.

vulnerabilities.summary: curl/libcurl SOCKS5 proxy handshake heap buffer overflow
vulnerabilities.details: A heap buffer overflow in the SOCKS5 proxy handshake affects curl and libcurl 7.69.0 through 8.3.0; fixed in 8.4.0.

vulnerabilities.summary: SYNTHETIC: acme-secoc freshness counter not persisted across ECU reset, allowing replay of authenticated PDUs
vulnerabilities.details: Synthetic advisory for training. The SecOC freshness value restarts at zero after a reset, so previously captured authenticated messages are accepted again until the counter catches up.

vulnerabilities.summary: SYNTHETIC: acme-autosar-com does not validate the received PDU length, leading to a buffer over-read
vulnerabilities.details: Synthetic advisory for training. A crafted CAN frame with a shorter DLC than configured makes the COM module read past the received data.

vulnerabilities.summary: SYNTHETIC: acme-bootloader leaves the debug unlock service enabled in production builds
vulnerabilities.details: Synthetic advisory for training. A diagnostic routine intended for development unlocks flash programming without security access.
